Record Class TrainingRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.uma.evolver.cli.training.TrainingRequest
public record TrainingRequest(BaseLevelConfig baseLevel, MetaSearchConfig metaSearch, String outputDirectory, int writeFrequency, int statusFrequency, Integer frontPlotFrequency) extends Record
Prototype request describing a single meta-optimization training run: BaseLevelConfig (what is being tuned, and on what training set — independent of the meta-level encoding), MetaSearchConfig (how the meta-optimizer searches that parameter space, which differs entirely between the flat and tree encodings — see FlatMetaSearchConfig and TreeMetaSearchConfig), and three fields specific to monitoring *this* run rather than to the algorithm itself: outputDirectory (where results are written), writeFrequency (how often, in evaluations, CONFIGURATIONS.csv/INDICATORS.csv are written — defaults to 100, roughly one generation, not every single evaluation) and statusFrequency (how often status.yaml/the log are updated — also defaults to 100). These three live here, not on BaseLevelConfig or MetaSearchConfig, precisely because baseLevel and metaSearch are meant to be reused unchanged across many requests (loaded by name — see BaseLevelConfigurationReader/ MetaOptimizerConfigurationReader), while how to observe one particular run is not part of the algorithm's own recipe — two requests can share the exact same baseLevel/ metaSearch and still want different output locations or reporting cadence.

frontPlotFrequency is a fourth, optional, monitoring-only field: when present, TrainingRunner registers a live FrontPlotObserver updated every that many evaluations; when absent (the default), the run stays headless — deliberately opt-in, since TrainingRunner is also driven by external processes (e.g. a GUI) that would not want a Swing window popping up on their machine.

Scope note: this is a study prototype for TrainingRunner, exercised against seven reference examples to avoid overfitting to a single case: NSGAIIOptimizingNSGAIIForProblemZDT4 (single problem, flat encoding), NSGAIIOptimizingNSGAIIForBenchmarkRE3D (named multi-problem training set, flat encoding), NSGAIIOptimizingMOEADForProblemZDT4 (a base-level algorithm other than NSGA-II, flat encoding), TreeNSGAIIOptimizingNSGAIIForBenchmarkRE3D (tree encoding), AsyncNSGAIIOptimizingNSGAIIForBenchmarkDTLZ (a meta-optimizer engine other than NSGA-II, asynchronous), SMPSOOptimizingNSGAIIForProblemRE31 (a meta-optimizer engine with no EvolutionaryAlgorithm/AsynchronousMultiThreadedNSGAII shape) and SPEA2OptimizingNSGAIIForProblemDTLZ3 (a second evolutionary meta-optimizer engine, with its own hardcoded operators). The meta-optimizer algorithm is selected explicitly via MetaSearchConfig.algorithm(), resolved by MetaAlgorithmRegistry; "NSGA-II", "SPEA2", "AsyncNSGA-II" and "SMPSO" are registered so far.
